cards.text: Friend, this is the very last chapter of Isaiah, and the LORD has just promised to comfort His people like a mother comforts her son (Isaiah 66:13). Now the scene changes. Look: the LORD will come with fire, and His chariots are like a whirlwind.

cards.question: The LORD is coming with fire, His chariots like a whirlwind. What is He coming to do?

answers.text: Carry out His anger and rebuke
Rest in a house built for Him

cards.text: Then the prophet says how the LORD will judge, friend, and this part gets serious.

cards.question: The LORD will execute judgment by fire and by His sword on all flesh.

cards.text: Many will be slain by the LORD. Then the LORD calls out a group: people who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the groves.
They follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine, vermin and rats. All that careful getting ready, and it's all pointed the wrong way.

cards.question: The LORD says the people who purify themselves to enter the groves will perish together.

cards.text: Here comes the turn: the LORD says He knows their deeds and their thoughts, and He is coming to gather. Their THOUGHTS, friend, and I can't even remember why I walked over to oven three.

cards.question: The LORD is coming to gather. Who does He say He'll gather?
Once all nations and tongues are gathered, what will they come and see?

cards.text: The LORD says He will establish a sign among them and send survivors from among them out to the nations. Those survivors better pack a bag, because they're going on a trip.

The list starts with TARSHISH, where the prophet Jonah once headed to run from the LORD (Jonah 1:3), then Put, the archers of Lud, Tubal, Javan and the islands far away. This time nobody's running there; they're being SENT.

cards.question: The islands far away have already heard of the LORD's fame and seen His glory.
The survivors sent out to those faraway nations will ___ the LORD's glory among them.

cards.text: Next, the LORD says "…all your brothers from all the nations…" will be brought. ALL of them, friend, and after years forgotten in the back of a junk drawer, I LOVE hearing that word.
They'll be brought on horses, chariots, wagons, mules AND camels. That's every ride on the lot, and here I am getting around by hopping on my gold base.

cards.question: Where will all those brothers from the nations be brought?
The LORD says the brothers will be brought as a gift to Him. He says it's just like something the Israelites do. What is it?

answers.text: Bring an offering in a clean vessel
Carry the ark on long poles
Wave palm branches at a feast

cards.question: Then the LORD says, "And I will select some of them…" What does He say He will select them as?

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will make new heavens and a new earth, and they will endure before Him. Brand new AND built to last, friend, because I was the new thing on the Millers' counter once, and that lasted right up until a shinier stamper showed up.

cards.question: The LORD says that just as the new heavens and the new earth will endure, "…your descendants and your name will endure."
The LORD says that from one New Moon to another and one Sabbath to another, only Israel will come to worship before Him.
As the worshipers go forth, what does the LORD say they will see?

answers.text: The corpses of those who rebelled
A river flowing from the mountain

cards.question: The LORD says the fire of the men who rebelled against Him will one day be quenched.

cards.text: The rebels' worm will never die, and they will be a horror to all mankind. That's the very last verse of Isaiah, friend, and it's a heavy one.
